title: centaurea jordaniana subsp. verguinii
intro: Centaurea jordaniana subsp. verguinii, commonly known as Jordan's knapweed, is a plant species within the Asteraceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects. The therapeutic actions of Jordan's knapweed are attributed to its ability to stimulate digestion and relieve gastrointestinal issues, as well as exhibit antioxidant and immunomodulatory activities. The bioactive constituents of Centaurea jordaniana subsp. verguinii include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
